content: The dissertation describes a warm letter from Akhlāṭī urging Ibn Turka to write a work establishing the propositions and conjunctions proper to the science of letters, adding 'perhaps the Mafāḥiṣ?'; Akhlāṭī calls him his bosom companion and the leading luminary among his brethren.
refers_to_primary: Letter of Akhlāṭī to Ibn Turka, MS Majlis 10196 (front matter of Munshaʾāt-i Turka)
